scope: artist-owned native per-family identity sources; no physics or RNG

grammar.silhouette: Central physical impact and outward pressure teeth
grammar.motion: Contact flash, spreading pressure fronts, staggered counter-pressure plates, fading chips
grammar.location: At the actual heavy contact point near the floor
grammar.palette: Cyan pressure, pale steel, sparse amber contact teeth
grammar.feature: Strong original ring composition; Rank II adds a second structural pressure response

impact_wake.notes: Rank I card preserves the original five editable layer cels and six accepted poses, each held for two half-duration keys. Rank I runtime must retain original 128px pressure tag in power_fx_002b.aseprite; no new wake tag is supplied so renderer falls through. New wake_ii is a structural counter-pressure response, not an enlarged recolour. Original source master retained intact.

grammar.silhouette: Off-centre metal rotor with broken hot plates and an asymmetric torn wake.
grammar.motion: Ignition, growing splinter density and irregular heat stutter; Breakneck loads, strikes, recoils.
grammar.location: Rotor edges and actual velocity wake; recoil near the floor.
grammar.persistence: Only real active/overcap/heat states; discrete ignition, commitment, strike and vent events.
grammar.palette: Oxide, hot orange, red and pale key flashes against cold steel.
grammar.feature: Open machine centre with unequal broken fragment banks; mutations change motion, not just hue.

notes: Successful C.4 fragmented Redline active signatures are intentionally retained by the integrated renderer. Fresh cards/icons and eight-key contact/overcap/heat/commit force-fragment states share their asymmetric hot mechanical grammar. No clean corona ring.
Runaway card frays after successive successful-contact action beats. Breakneck uses a visible small rival and loaded/strike/recoil poses.

grammar.silhouette: Thick compressed physical rotor braced against a visible wall bank.
grammar.motion: Wall-side squeeze, abruptly separated flight positions, violent contact and short scrape aftermath.
grammar.location: Wall contact, actual rebound vector, then target contact and floor scars.
grammar.persistence: Armed wall-rebound lifetime plus bounded charge/contact/aftermath events.
grammar.palette: Cold iron, silver, brass and small white/gold contact flashes.
grammar.feature: The wall and the whole spinning machine tell the slingshot story; disconnected heavy plates replace any wedge.

notes: Rank II adds a second wall-side brace and denser separated metal wakes, not a larger surrounding aura.
Charge cels leave the machine centre open. Card stack height visibly compresses; runtime may compress cosmetic stack only, preserving collision geometry.

grammar.silhouette: Heavy compact machine borne by inward floor jaws
grammar.motion: Jaws approach, machine settles, grounded teeth take a strike; Counterweight compresses then sends force outward
grammar.location: Floor contact point and low weight-bearing braces
grammar.persistence: Charge-stage floor lock, with short impact/release reactions
grammar.palette: Pale steel and slate ground, restrained cyan teeth, amber stored force
grammar.feature: Visible mass supported by closing ground jaws; Bulwark redirects incoming contact and Counterweight stores a mechanical load

dead_centre.notes: Retain accepted exact anchor charge/grounding state, signature posture and actual directional Counterweight force composition. New native jaw cels carry more weight at the same fixed floor pivot. Bulwark card shows a planted rig meeting an attack; Counterweight card gives the loaded side cylinder a different composition. No long trails, aura growth or new mechanics.

grammar.silhouette: A leading physical machine and environmental scars; Ghost encloses a rival in an irregular latched route
grammar.motion: Route is drawn behind motion, aged crossing snaps locally, Ghost sockets meet and the actual path locks
grammar.location: Recorded routes, endpoints and actual crossing points
grammar.persistence: Bounded route history plus finite latch/crossing responses
grammar.palette: Sparse cyan and ice scars; Ghost uses green mechanical route teeth
grammar.feature: The route occupies the illustration and gameplay space; Ghost closure and Slipstream crossing have different spatial and timing language

afterimage.notes: Retain strong actual-route geometry and native afterimage_fx_002c4 scar/crossing logic; do not substitute a pre-drawn circle for live recorded routes. New endpoint, lock and crossing tiles are local accents. Ghost card shows an enclosed rival and a closing irregular machine path; Slipstream shows a physical top accelerating across an old route. No persistent player aura.

grammar.silhouette: Unequal physical receivers joined by diagonal contact transmission
grammar.motion: One machine hits, a tooth lights, then the next receiver reacts; alternating compressed contact accents
grammar.location: Real elimination/contact origin and actual eligible receiver links
grammar.persistence: Discrete transmitted events, no persistent player aura
grammar.palette: Dark steel receivers, copper stress, short pale amber contact keys
grammar.feature: Sequential local contact teeth and sparse physical receiver links instead of a radial blast

chain_impact.notes: Cards deliberately show unequal machines in a diagonal relay; Rank II extends the relay rather than growing the source pulse. FX are local contact teeth only. Runtime must place accents and short links along actual eligible target positions captured in presentation metadata, not use the legacy fixed RIGHT or fake illustrated runtime tops. Cascade mechanics unchanged.

grammar.silhouette: Off-axis strained machine with a single large stepped pawl catching its bearing.
grammar.motion: Uneven slips/misses, decisive pawl contact, a short stutter catch and restrained settlement.
grammar.location: One side of the low bearing and contact-floor scrape.
grammar.persistence: Intermittent actual danger window; bounded successful-contact catch.
grammar.palette: Dull steel/brass, small gold tooth tips, oxide strain marks and one pale catch flash.
grammar.feature: Asymmetric toothed L-shaped pawl and leaning bit; no recovery-ring expansion or relaunch.

notes: Rank II adds a second small staggered bearing stop, not a surrounding symmetric clamp.
The authored catch never resets the physical player, reserve, collision radius or position.

grammar.silhouette: Forward-cropped low rotor and widely spaced narrow wake lanes; Flow has two long open guide rails.
grammar.motion: Intervals stretch as thrust rises. Terminal uses sparse long discontinuities; Flow retains a smooth bend.
grammar.location: Behind the moving rotor along the actual velocity.
grammar.persistence: Moving speed state; terminal surge is event-based.
grammar.palette: Steel, ice and cool blue; muted mint retained rails; sparse terminal brass tips.
grammar.feature: Terminal discontinuous spacing versus Flow continuous parallel retention remains distinct in grayscale.

notes: Rank II adds a second low transmission shoe and a third interrupted wake lane.
Flow rails are open rotor-height guides. Orbit instead cuts a compact concave floor crescent and ejects grit.

grammar.silhouette: Large sideways machine over a broad hooked contact-floor skid.
grammar.motion: Enter turn, cut a growing outside hook, throw grit and release the arc.
grammar.location: Floor/contact point outside the turn, below the rotor.
grammar.persistence: Only actual brake-turn drift/arc state; scuffs settle after the carving beat.
grammar.palette: Worn steel floor scars, muted teal edge and brass grit.
grammar.feature: One short concave floor cut with displaced outer grit; no rotor aura or long Flow rails.

notes: Rank II adds a second outside skid groove and extra displaced grit, staying at the contact plane.

grammar.silhouette: contact-side telescoping twin rods and broad end-stop
grammar.motion: incoming compression, mechanical shortening, damped rebound
grammar.location: incoming contact side of real top, no floor fortress
grammar.persistence: contact event only; no automatically orbiting shield
grammar.palette: cool gray steel, pale mint faceplate and restrained brass seals
grammar.feature: an exposed piston physically changes length rather than expanding an aura

notes: New individually directed native master; old source retained for before/after.
Anticipation, action, reaction and follow-through are separate authored poses, not a uniformly spinning six-frame loop.
Rank II adds physical structure rather than palette substitution.
Cards illustrate actual machines; FX deliberately omit replacement rotors to keep gameplay subjects visible.
Icon is a separately drawn small-scale silhouette.

All eight projected headings have native keyed placements/strokes. Machinery stays upright; no sprite rotation/resampling. No duplicate base tags: directional variants cover every actual heading while the largest bank sheet remains below 4096 pixels tall.

grammar.silhouette: rear open spring cassette and broad brake shoe, forward moving top
grammar.motion: gradual compression, held load, abrupt extension and sparse directed release
grammar.location: rear braking side/contact plane; release follows actual movement vector
grammar.persistence: real charge stages while stored; compression/release are events
grammar.palette: brass, graphite, warm ivory with steel mount
grammar.feature: visible helical coil pitch shrinks as real stored force rises
